title: Decision No.68(2022) On the Extension of the Reconciliation Period for Licensees
text:
Communication & Information Technology Regulatory Authority
April 19, 2022
Decision (68) of 2022
On the extension of the reconciliation period for licensees based on the guidance note of
the regulatory bylaws of specifications and requirements for the construction and
operation of radio communication stations
Chairman of the Board of Directors:
Having reviewed Law No. 37 of 2014 establishing the Communication & Information
Technology Regulatory Authority issued on May 8, 2014 and amended by Law No. (98) of
2015
Cabinet Resolution No. 993 of 2015 issued on 13/7/2015 enacting the Executive Regulations
of Law No. 37 of 2014 referred to
Decree No. 312 of 2018 to form the Board of Directors of the Tra and Information
Technology Authority
Board of Directors Decision adopted at its meeting No. 2020/1 held on 2020/1/8 on the
issuance of the regulatory bylaws of construction specifications and requirements and the
operation of public radio stations and its guidance note
The Board of Directors approval at its meeting No. 2022/3 held on 24/2/2022, and
For reasons bearing on the best interests of work.
Article One
The provisions of this decision shall apply to all licensees and those concerned with correcting
or reconciling their situation in accordance with the provisions of the regulatory bylaws of
specifications and requirements for the construction and operation of public radio stations
and their guidance note.
Article Two
The situation reconciliation period will be extended for 24 months as from February 13,
2022.
Article Three
All concerned stakeholders must implement the decision.
Article Four
Any stipulation or provision that violates or contradicts the provisions of this decision shall be
repealed.

Article Five
The decision shall be published in the Official Gazette and its provisions apply from the date
it is published.
Chairman of the Board of Directors
Communications and Information Technology Regulatory Authority
Eng. Salem Munib Al-Authaina
